body:
I took six 50mg tramadol, and I must say that I compare it to hydrocodone.  Not quite as much good feeling, but the difference is barely noticeable.  Why tramadol is a class III is beyond me, not that I want them to change it.  Good stuff.  Got 180ct for less than $120.
